article.title: How to Validate JSON Data Against JSON Schema
article.content:
What is JSON Schema Validation?

JSON Schema validation checks whether JSON data conforms to a defined structure, data types, and constraints. A JSON Schema describes what a valid JSON document should look like, including required properties, allowed types, value ranges, and patterns.

This type of validation is essential for ensuring data quality in APIs, configuration files, data pipelines, and any system that relies on structured JSON input.

Why Validate Against Schema?

  • API quality: Ensure incoming requests and outgoing responses match the expected format
  • Data integrity: Validate data before processing or storing it
  • Error prevention: Catch structural and type errors early in development
  • Documentation: Use the schema as living documentation of your data contract
  • Consistency: Enforce consistent shapes across different services and clients

What Can JSON Schema Validate?

  • Data types: string, number, integer, boolean, array, object, null
  • Required fields: Mark specific properties as mandatory
  • Constraints: Minimum and maximum values, string lengths, regex patterns, enum lists
  • Nested structures: Validate complex nested objects and arrays with items and additionalProperties
  • Conditional rules: Apply different subschemas based on conditions (in more advanced schemas)

How to Validate JSON Against a Schema

  1. Paste JSON data: Add the JSON document you want to validate in the JSON Data field.
  2. Paste JSON Schema: Add the JSON Schema that defines the expected structure and constraints.
  3. Click Validate: Run the validation to check whether the JSON conforms to the schema.
  4. Review results: If validation succeeds, you will see a success message. If it fails, review the detailed errors with paths and descriptions.
  5. Fix and re-validate: Adjust your JSON or schema based on the error messages, then run validation again.

Common Schema Keywords

  • type: Define the expected data type (object, array, string, number, etc.)
  • required: List property names that must be present
  • properties: Define the structure and subschemas for object properties
  • items: Define the schema for array elements
  • minimum / maximum: Set numeric value constraints
  • minLength / maxLength: Set string length constraints
  • pattern: Enforce a regular expression pattern on strings
  • enum: Restrict a value to a fixed set of allowed options

Typical Use Cases

  • API testing: Validate request and response bodies against API schemas
  • Configuration validation: Ensure configuration files match the expected structure
  • Data contracts: Enforce agreed-upon data shapes between services
  • Form data: Validate JSON generated from forms or UI components
  • ETL and pipelines: Check incoming data before transformation or loading

Tips for Effective Schema Validation

  • Start with a clear schema: Define your data contract before validating large amounts of data
  • Use descriptive errors: Leverage the error paths to quickly locate issues in nested structures
  • Iterate gradually: Begin with a simple schema, then add more constraints as needed
  • Separate concerns: Use different schemas for different contexts (e.g., create vs update payloads)
  • Keep schemas versioned: Track schema changes alongside your API or data format versions

Client-Side Privacy

This JSON Schema validator processes input in your browser instead of requiring an upload to a remote service. That can be convenient for development data and private configuration snippets. However, you should still avoid entering passwords, API keys, access tokens, or other highly sensitive information into any browser-based tool.

article.title: 如何根据 JSON Schema 验证 JSON 数据
article.content:
什么是 JSON Schema 验证？

JSON Schema 验证用于检查 JSON 数据是否符合定义的结构、数据类型和约束条件。JSON Schema 描述了“合法的”JSON 文档应该长什么样，包括必需的属性、允许的类型、取值范围和模式等。

这种验证对于确保 API、配置文件、数据管道以及任何依赖结构化 JSON 输入的系统中的数据质量非常重要。

为什么要根据 Schema 验证？

  • API 质量：确保传入请求和传出响应符合预期格式
  • 数据完整性：在处理或存储数据之前进行校验
  • 错误预防：在开发早期发现结构和类型错误
  • 文档作用：将 Schema 作为数据契约的活文档
  • 一致性：在不同服务和客户端之间强制执行一致的数据形状

JSON Schema 可以验证什么？

  • 数据类型：string、number、integer、boolean、array、object、null
  • 必填字段：将某些属性标记为必须存在
  • 约束条件：最小/最大值、字符串长度、正则模式、枚举列表等
  • 嵌套结构：验证包含多层对象和数组的复杂结构
  • 条件规则：在更高级的 Schema 中，根据条件应用不同的子 Schema

如何根据 Schema 验证 JSON

  1. 粘贴 JSON 数据：在“JSON 数据”字段中添加要验证的 JSON 文档。
  2. 粘贴 JSON Schema：在“JSON Schema”字段中添加定义预期结构和约束的 Schema。
  3. 点击验证：运行验证，检查 JSON 是否符合 Schema。
  4. 查看结果：如果验证成功，会看到成功提示；如果失败，会看到带路径和描述的错误列表。
  5. 修复并重新验证：根据错误信息调整 JSON 或 Schema，然后再次运行验证。

常见 Schema 关键字

  • type：定义预期的数据类型（object、array、string、number 等）
  • required：列出必须存在的属性名
  • properties：为对象的各个属性定义结构和子 Schema
  • items：为数组元素定义 Schema
  • minimum / maximum：设置数值的上下限
  • minLength / maxLength：设置字符串长度约束
  • pattern：为字符串设置正则表达式模式
  • enum：将值限制在一组固定的可选值之内

典型使用场景

  • API 测试：验证请求体和响应体是否符合 API Schema
  • 配置校验：确保配置文件符合预期结构
  • 数据契约：在服务之间强制执行约定的数据形状
  • 表单数据：验证由表单或 UI 组件生成的 JSON
  • ETL 和流水线：在转换或加载之前检查输入数据

高效进行 Schema 验证的技巧

  • 先定义清晰的 Schema：在验证大量数据之前，先明确数据契约
  • 利用详细错误：通过错误路径快速定位嵌套结构中的问题
  • 逐步迭代：从简单 Schema 开始，再根据需要增加约束
  • 区分场景：为不同场景使用不同 Schema（例如创建和更新载荷）
  • 版本化管理：将 Schema 变更与 API 或数据格式版本一起管理

浏览器本地处理与隐私

这个 JSON Schema 验证器在浏览器中处理输入内容，不要求将数据上传到远程服务。对于开发数据和私密配置片段来说，本地处理更加方便。不过，仍然不建议在任何浏览器工具中输入密码、API 密钥、访问令牌或其他高度敏感的信息。
